nuggets.text: Ravens coach Jesse Minter once rapped Eminem's 'Lose Yourself' at a team dinner.
Jesse Minter and his father, Rick Minter, once coached together at Georgia State, with the son running the defense.
Ravens coach Jesse Minter played wide receiver at the College of Mount Saint Joseph in Delhi, Ohio.
Jesse Minter is just the fourth head coach in Ravens history, after Ted Marchibroda, Brian Billick and John Harbaugh.
The Ravens are named for Edgar Allan Poe's poem 'The Raven,' picked in a fan contest that drew 33,288 voters.
The Ravens' marching band began in 1947 as the Baltimore Colts Marching Band and never disbanded after the Colts left.
The Ravens' new uniforms introduce Midnight Purple, a color-shifting fabric designed to mimic a raven's feathers.
Lamar Jackson won the 2016 Heisman Trophy at 19 years, 337 days, the youngest winner in the award's history.
Lamar Jackson is the NFL's all-time leading rusher among quarterbacks.
Derrick Henry is the only player to rush for 2,000 yards in a season in high school, college and the NFL.
